scope: Compose H0 container build and local runtime E2E

notes: Build used Docker's classic builder because buildx was unavailable.
The initial clean Router image build exposed missing hashed cffi and pycparser dependencies; the lock was corrected and the clean build then passed.

runtime.test_engine: Dos recorridos sobre el mismo Compose privado: perfil mock autocontenido y Atenhea real local vía host.docker.internal:11436; el engine no publicó puertos en el bridge.
runtime.test_override: none; el mismo manifiesto Compose arranca el mock interno y los servicios de producto
runtime.http_allowlist: NEXUS_H1_ALLOW_HTTP_SERVICE_NAME=mock-atenea, coincidencia exacta para el hostname del servicio

host_worker_e2e.worker_location: host process in a network namespace separate from the Colima Compose services
host_worker_e2e.router_access: temporary published port 127.0.0.1:18443 with CA-verified TLS
host_worker_e2e.enrollment: pass with dedicated host node identity and enrollment secret

strict_pki_compatibility.initial_finding: OpenSSL 4/Python 3.15 rejected the original Router leaf certificate because it lacked Authority Key Identifier.
strict_pki_compatibility.bootstrap_fix: new CA includes Subject Key Identifier and Authority Key Identifier; new Router leaf includes both identifiers
strict_pki_compatibility.rotation_fix: new leaf includes identifiers and strict verify supports legacy private CAs that already have SKI
strict_pki_compatibility.system_openssl4_tls_handshake: pass; unauthenticated metrics request returned HTTP 401 after TLS handshake
strict_pki_compatibility.runtime_materials: local test CA certificate reissued under the same offline private key; protected backups retained
strict_pki_compatibility.legacy_ca_rotation_fixture: strict leaf verifies against a legacy test CA with SKI but no AKI

limitations: The real engine test used the locally available model advertised as athenea-e2b:latest; no model artifact hash, weights provenance, full-output quality evaluation, or performance benchmark was verified in this Compose run.
Both Compose runs were local on Colima; GitHub Actions was not dispatched or observed.

The CA used for this local rehearsal is stored under /private/tmp and is not durable; production use requires protecting an offline CA key in durable encrypted storage and managing its backup/recovery lifecycle.
The separate worker test ran as a host process reaching a Colima container through loopback; it does not prove connectivity or failure recovery between two physical hosts or independent networks.

h0_protocol_regression.live_router_stale_model_check: pass; synthetic stale model entry removed after check

isolated_mock_e2e_2026_10_26.override: temporary Compose override; separate Docker volumes initialized inside Colima
notes: Built router-worker, API, web, and mock images from current source.
Isolated state used temporary Docker named volumes; no project ledger volume was mounted.
The first bind-mount attempt failed because Colima presented host ownership as root; the isolated named-volume retry passed.
